SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_settlement_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND bill_type=#{type.code} AND bill_id=#{billId} AND cash_id=#{cashId} AND reversal_of IS NULL AND reversed=FALSE)
